I went from Airpods 2 to these Airpods 4. Sound quality wise, they’re an amazing upgrade. Size wise, the “stems” of each airpod is shorter which can make them feel less stable in your ears than the older generations. Overall it’s a good upgrade. However, the part that actually sits in your ear is quite significantly larger than older generations (in my case, the airpods 2), which can be a bit of a struggle when you place the airpods in your ears. I had no problems fitting my old airpods 2 in my ears to sit comfortably and snug but with these ones, I find my right airpod does not sit in my right ear properly. I understand this is just due to the shape of my ears but just an fyi and comparison for your reference. Also I got these on sale for $128.99 during the black friday sale and honestly I wouldn’t pay more for these so I’d highly suggest waiting for these to go on sale before you purchase them!
